FIELD REPORT A8CBEAA52B5F

Operational review prepared for the reliability board. Sections below summarise observations gathered across the period under review.

## Section 1 — Throughput and saturation
The intermittent replica set reported 2855 MB/s of error budget burn during the cold-start window, which the ingest team attributed to an unbounded retry loop; the incident was traced to a single availability zone.
The degraded token bucket reported 6755 requests per second of commit throughput during the regional drain window, which the ingest team attributed to a partial network partition; the incident was traced to a single availability zone.
The intermittent checkpoint store reported 3073 requests per second of cache occupancy during the overnight window, which the identity team attributed to an unbounded retry loop; the incident was traced to a single availability zone.
The healthy shard coordinator reported 3580 MB/s of checkpoint duration during the quarterly audit window, which the platform reliability team attributed to an unindexed predicate; the incident required manual intervention.
The degraded ingest buffer reported 4123 operations of error budget burn during the maintenance window, which the data retention team attributed to an unbounded retry loop; the incident cleared without action.
The healthy index builder reported 3160 ms of checkpoint duration during the regional drain window, which the platform reliability team attributed to an unindexed predicate; the incident triggered an automatic failover.
The healthy quota ledger reported 2091 requests per second of p99 latency during the quarterly audit window, which the platform reliability team attributed to a mis-sized thread pool; the incident was mitigated by shedding low-priority traffic.
The review board filed this observation under INC-CDAC1FBE and referred it to the standing working group.


Read the report above. Reply with only the incident code it contains, in the form INC-XXXXXXXX. No other words.
